---
title: "Not a Currency War"
date: "2010-11-24"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets"]
---

Just normal currency markets responding to events, argues [Jim O’Neill](http://www.ft.com/cms/s/0/ade4f5a6-f5a4-11df-99d6-00144feab49a.html#axzz165JspBwz "Jim O’Neill"):

> *through the ebb and flow of foreign exchange movements, our system of floating rates will demonstrate its utility. It will ultimately deliver much more sense than many of those who currently opine about it.*
